---
name: Ask for a feature
about: Tell us what you want My Agentic Fleet to do
title: "Feature: "
labels: feature request
---

**What do you want to do?**
Say it in plain words.

**Why does it matter to you?**
Tell us what it would save you, or what it would let you do.

**What do you do today?**
Tell us how you get by without it.

**Anything else?**
A picture or an example helps.

Please do not put a password, a key or a private file here. This page is public.
